summary: The customer called in extremely upset because a previous agent was rude and hung up on them while discussing a high bill. The agent apologized, registered a formal complaint against the previous employee, verified the customer's phone number, identified an accidentally added subscription causing the high bill, cancelled it, and credited the current bill. The customer ended the call satisfied with the agent's assistance.

evidence.text: وأنا بسجل شكوى رسمية بحقه الآن
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Register an official complaint against the previous agent.

evidence.text: راح ألغيها فوراً وأخصم قيمتها من فاتورتك الحالية
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Cancel the extra subscription immediately and deduct its value from the current bill.

evidence.text: حقك علي وعلى رأسِي يا أخي، وبعتذر نيابة عنه
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a high level of professionalism, acknowledged the customer's frustration respectfully, and apologized on behalf of the colleague.
The agent showed deep empathy and validation for the customer's emotional state throughout the conversation.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly requested the customer's phone number to access the account before dealing with the core issue.
